description: This PHP source file defines the 'updatePortal' class, which manages user updates and email notifications within the SuiteCRM system, including sending emails via SMTP and handling user account access updates.

classes.name: updatePortal
classes.description: A class responsible for updating user information and sending email notifications in the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user information and sends an email if the user has Joomla account access.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Constructs and sends an email message, and records it in the system if sending is successful.
